user.title: Set Up Latter System
user.description: Create the Latter System hub. Optionally select your first ESPHome Device running Latter firmware, or leave it blank to start with standalone BLE Area presence and sensor fusion and add Devices later in Latter Studio.

user.title: Add a BLE Tag
user.description: Track a phone, watch, or Bluetooth tag through your Bluetooth proxies. Latter adds a device_tracker, Area, and distance sensors for it.

data.name: Name
data.ble_target_address: MAC address, iBeacon UUID, or tracker entity

data_description.name: Used for the entity IDs (for example `Alex's Phone` gives `sensor.alex_s_phone_current_area`).
data_description.ble_target_address: A static MAC address, an iBeacon UUID, or a `private_ble_device` / iBeacon tracker entity ID.
data_description.assigned_person: Optional. Notifications sent to a person, and occupancy, use it.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure BLE Tag
reconfigure.description: Update this BLE tag's display name, Bluetooth target address, or assigned person.

data.name: Name
data.ble_target_address: MAC address, iBeacon UUID, or tracker entity

data_description.name: Display title for this BLE tag (existing entity IDs stay unchanged).
data_description.ble_target_address: A static MAC address, an iBeacon UUID, or a `private_ble_device` / iBeacon tracker entity ID.
data_description.assigned_person: Optional. Notifications sent to a person, and occupancy, use it.

abort.already_configured: A BLE tag with this name or address is already configured.

error.ble_tag_incomplete: Enter a name and a MAC address, iBeacon UUID, or tracker entity.

confirm.title: Update mapped entities for {device_slug}
confirm.description: The following entities mapped to **{device_slug}** could not be found in Home Assistant: **{missing_list}**. Open the Latter Studio to select replacement entities, then confirm below to clear this warning.

ble_no_proxies.title: No Area-assigned Bluetooth proxies found for {device_slug}

confirm.title: Assign Bluetooth proxies to Home Assistant Areas
confirm.description: Built-in BLE Area Tracking is enabled for **{device_slug}**, but no Bluetooth scanner proxies assigned to a Home Assistant Area were detected. Assign your ESPHome BLE proxies to their corresponding Areas in Home Assistant, or disable BLE tracking if stationary.

confirm.title: Verify ESPHome connection and firmware for {device_slug}
confirm.description: Latter failed to push browse or area slots to **{device_slug}** 5 consecutive times ({service_name}: {error}). Verify that the ESPHome device is online and running matching Protocol v3 firmware.

link_ma_player.title: Pick the Music Assistant player for {device_slug}

pick.title: Link {device_slug} to its Music Assistant player
pick.description: Music Assistant doesn't report this device's MAC address or device, so Latter can't find the Music Assistant player behind **{speaker_entity}** on its own. Pick **{device_slug}**'s player once. Library playback, queues and lyrics on the device use it. You can change it later in Latter Studio (device → Audio).

abort.device_removed: This device is no longer part of Latter.

error.invalid_ma_player: Pick a Music Assistant media player.

confirm.title: {device} crashed
confirm.description: **{device}** reported a crash reset (**{reason}**) when it booted at {time} (Latter SDK rev {sdk}). Open the device's logs in ESPHome Device Builder before it restarts again: the decoded backtrace is shown there. Decoding needs the build the device is running. Confirm to dismiss; a new crash raises this again.

confirm.title: {device} lost power briefly
confirm.description: **{device}** reported a brownout reset when it booted at {time} (Latter SDK rev {sdk}): its supply voltage sagged below the safe level. Check the power supply, the USB cable, or the battery. Confirm to dismiss; a new brownout raises this again.

confirm.title: {device} rolled back its firmware
confirm.description: The last firmware update on **{device}** failed to boot, so the device went back to the previous firmware (Latter SDK rev {sdk}, reported at {time}). Check the build logs, then install the update again. This clears after a successful update.

reset_ble_tag_has_no_device_settings.message: A BLE tag has no settings saved on a device. Reset only its Latter settings.

notify.name: Send Notification
notify.description: Show an on-screen notification with an optional chime or camera snapshot on a Latter Device, occupied Areas, a person's Devices, or all displays.

target_device.name: Target Device or Routing Mode
target_device.description: ESPHome device slug, occupied_areas, all, or a person entity ID.

title.name: Alert Title
title.description: Short heading for the notification banner.

priority.name: Priority Level
priority.description: Visual urgency of the alert (normal, warning, critical).

duration.name: Display Duration (Seconds)
duration.description: How many seconds to show the alert overlay on screen.

chime.name: Play Chime
chime.description: Play an alert chime on the device speaker when the notification arrives.

announce.name: Speak Message
announce.description: Also speak the message with TTS on the device.

camera_entity.name: Camera Entity
camera_entity.description: Optional camera entity whose snapshot is shown with the notification.

intercom_broadcast.name: Intercom Broadcast
intercom_broadcast.description: Broadcast a TTS announcement or local audio clip to explicit target speakers, occupied Areas, a person's Area, or configured broadcast speakers.

target_device.name: Calling Device or Routing Mode
target_device.description: Optional calling Latter device slug, occupied_areas, all, or a person entity ID.

message.name: Announcement Message (TTS)

media_url.name: Audio Clip URL

target_speakers.name: Target Speakers
target_speakers.description: Specific media_player entities to broadcast to.

area_id.name: Area ID or Area Name
area_id.description: Target Home Assistant area_id or friendly Area name.

set_active_speaker.name: Set Active Speaker
set_active_speaker.description: Change the active target media_player for the Latter Device and optionally transfer the active playback queue.

transfer_queue.name: Transfer Active Queue

target_device.name: Target Device
